summary: Frontend-only E2E of new INVENTORY feature (Products page + /inventory). Login as owner.inventory@qasirtest.com succeeded. Products table columns Modal/Harga/Stok Min/Stok/Aksi Stok all present. Low-stock badge + rose row highlight for 'Pisang Goreng (Stok Tipis)' verified. Add Stock, Reduce Stock, Adjust Stock flows all functioned end-to-end via supabase.rpc('record_stock_movement') and reflected updated stock in the table with correct 'Stok diperbarui' toasts. Negative-stock guard returned the exact 'Stok tidak boleh negatif' toast and left stock unchanged. Create product with initial Stok Saat Ini = 8 appeared with Stok=8 and the Stok Saat Ini input is correctly DISABLED in edit mode. CRITICAL BUG FOUND on /inventory: fetchMovements() returns 400 from Supabase REST — PGRST200 'Could not find a relationship between stock_movements and profiles in the schema cache'. The Inventory table never leaves the 'Memuat…' state and shows 0 rows, so product/type filtering cannot be validated. Cleanup: created test product (TEST_InvProduct_X9_edited) was DELETED via product-delete-<id>; all 7 pre-existing products remain intact (verified).

critical.issue: 400 PGRST200 — PostgREST cannot find FK relationship between public.stock_movements and public.profiles. stock_movements.created_by presumably references auth.users(id), not public.profiles(id), so the embedded resource 'creator:profiles(full_name,email)' in fetchMovements fails for ALL queries. Inventory page therefore shows 0 movements and remains stuck in loading. Fix: either (a) add an FK constraint in migration_inventory.sql: ALTER TABLE public.stock_movements ADD CONSTRAINT stock_movements_created_by_profiles_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES public.profiles(id); then use creator:profiles!stock_movements_created_by_profiles_fkey(full_name,email), OR (b) change the join hint to the existing FK, e.g. creator:profiles!created_by(full_name,email) once such FK exists, OR (c) drop the join and fetch creators in a second query keyed by created_by.

ui_bugs.issue: On fetchMovements error the UI stays in 'Memuat…' forever (useQuery sets isLoading=false on error, but there is no error branch rendering — reality shows blank/loading because the query error isn't surfaced). Add an error state row with retry.

integration_issues.issue: Entire flow blocked by the Supabase 400 above. Could not validate inventory-filter-product, inventory-filter-type, positive-green / negative-red rendering, or that purchase/adjustment/sale rows show up.

critical_code_review_comments: lib/inventory.js fetchMovements: creator:profiles(full_name,email) will always 400 unless an explicit FK from stock_movements.created_by -> profiles(id) exists. Supabase/PostgREST does not auto-infer joins through auth.users. Current PGRST200 error confirms no such FK is in the public schema cache.
Inventory.jsx uses `isLoading` only; it ignores the `error` field from useQuery, so query failures are invisible to the user. Add { error } and render a retry/empty error row.
Products.jsx del() uses window.confirm instead of AlertDialog; inconsistent with rest of app and not testable via data-testid.
StockForm 'adjust' mode allows setting stock to 0 but the only guard is `delta === 0` toast; consider explicit confirmation when setting a large positive delta (potential typos).
STOCK_MODE.add.desc contains a cyrillic character ('restок') — minor typo.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run inventory_page tests after main agent adds FK from stock_movements.created_by -> public.profiles(id) and updates fetchMovements select hint. Pre-existing product list is intact (7 products). 'Air Mineral 600ml' stock was adjusted during this run.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: supabase/migration_inventory.sql created stock_movements.created_by as a UUID (likely referencing auth.users(id)) but did NOT add a foreign key to public.profiles(id). PostgREST's embedded-resource syntax creator:profiles(...) requires an FK in the exposed schema to disambiguate the join; without it PostgREST returns PGRST200. REPRO: login as owner.inventory@qasirtest.com, open /inventory — Network tab shows GET /rest/v1/stock_movements?...creator:profiles(...) -> 400 {code: PGRST200}. MITIGATION: Add in migration: ALTER TABLE public.stock_movements ADD CONSTRAINT stock_movements_created_by_profiles_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; then adjust select to creator:profiles!stock_movements_created_by_profiles_fkey(full_name,email) (or keep implicit if only one FK path). Reload PostgREST schema cache (NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';).
